minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, October 16, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee Was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 16, 2019.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, Chick Campo, Lorraine Missick, George Borst, and
  Bette Donovan
  Members absent: Scott Snider
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre - Staff Liaison, Yvonne Duran - Recreation Coordinator,
  and Brandon Granillo - Recreation Coordinator.
  Guests Present: Liz Kirk, La Verne resident
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, September
  18, 2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Program: The average meals served for September was 37.

4. Bingo Report: September: Beginning balance was $2,368; ending balance was
  $2,468.37; change was $100.37. Average of 48 players per session. Expenses paid
  - $535.33 to Bingo West and $5.00 Bank Fee. Total checks $540.33. Saved $700
  with the new prices for the special games.
  Two people came from the ad in the Bingo Bugle. Yvonne mentioned she would
  send in the drawing for the Bugle. Computer is all setup. Jeff from Bingo West is
  coming out to check everything. New program will be setup by George. The changes
  have made a difference.
5. Meals on Wheels: No September report.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $4,363.66.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Bridge not paid. Will give updated
  information on Guitar and Line Dancing next month.
 New Business

8. Upcoming Events:
  Saturday, October 19th– Halloween Parade at Heritage Plaza, 10:00 AM
  Wednesday, October 30th – Health & Resource Fair, and Flu Shots 9:00 – 11:30 AM
  Thursday, October 31st – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Halloween theme), 11:30
  AM
  Monday, November 11th – Center closed in observance of Veterans Day & Veterans
  Day Ceremony at Veteran’s Hall.

9. DPSS ⸺ Cal Fresh Food Benefits: No report.

10. Facilities Report: Fixed a line filled with grease in the kitchen. Will replace all the
  grease traps. Public Works is helping with this project. The total cost to be
  determined. Veterans Hall new A/C unit is completed, carpet needs repairing and
  looking into replacing it with tile.

11. Public Comments: Chic has retired from RSVP.

  YWCA needs sponsorship for a volunteer program. Motion made and approved to
  donate $100.00 to the YWCA Annual “Volunteers Make a World of Difference
  Service Awards” Event.

  Brandon announced Community Senior Services changed their name to
  “AgingNext”. Flyers were left at the center, introducing all of the programs they have
  to offer. Additionally, they are still based out of Claremont. RSVP is now Volunteers.
  No funds from Pomona Valley Transit Authority. The Health Fair has 27 vendors
  signed up and Flu Shots will be available. The Senior Dinner Dance in November
  had 70 individuals pre-registered.

12. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  The next meeting will be held on Wednesday, November 20th at 10:00 AM.
